answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. This works because the originality bar tightens as more low-quality answers appear, raising the per-alias cost of a coordinated fake campaign. The mechanism therefore aligns self-interest with network health: an attacker gains most by behaving honestly, because that is the only move that scales. Consider a pulse as the anchor of the cost. A ocean stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a pigment hold...
